title: Ridiculous Cost
text: Ridiculous Cost. The filter cost, at $30 per, is at least $360 per year, per unit.  I don't have a large home.  I have 4 units.  That is nearly $1,500 annually plus the cost of electricity to run them.  Weigh the costs carefully.
